scripts.pnl: npm run proxy && npm run launch
scripts.test: npm run unittest && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e: npm pack && npm run e2e-commonjs && npm run e2e-esm
scripts.e2e-commonjs:default: cd test/e2e/commonjs && npm uninstall $npm_package_name && npm ci && npm i ../../../$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.tgz --ignore-scripts && npm run test
scripts.e2e-commonjs:win32: cd test\e2e\commonjs && npm uninstall %npm_package_name% && npm ci && npm i ..\..\..\%npm_package_name%-%npm_package_version%.tgz --ignore-scripts && npm run test
scripts.e2e-esm:default: cd test/e2e/esm && npm uninstall $npm_package_name && npm ci && npm i ../../../$npm_package_name-$npm_package_version.tgz --ignore-scripts && npm run test
scripts.e2e-esm:win32: cd test\e2e\esm && npm uninstall %npm_package_name% && npm ci && npm i ..\..\..\%npm_package_name%-%npm_package_version%.tgz --ignore-scripts && npm run test
scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.publish.json && shx mkdir dist/commands && shx cp src/commands/index.* dist/commands/ && shx chmod +x dist/launchers/*.js
